Package org.checkerframework.framework.stub

package org.checkerframework.framework.stub
  • Class
    Description
    AnnotationFileElementTypes
    Holds information about types parsed from annotation files (stub files or ajava files).
    AnnotationFileElementTypesTest
    Unit test for AnnotationFileElementTypes.buildSigIndex(java.util.List<javax.lang.model.element.ExecutableElement>) and AnnotationFileElementTypes.findAnnotatedJdk(java.lang.Class<?>).
    AnnotationFileParser
    This class has three static methods.
    AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileAnnotations
    The result of calling AnnotationFileParser.parse: the annotated types and declaration annotations from the file.
    AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileParserException
    An exception indicating a problem while parsing an annotation file.
    AnnotationFileParser.RecordComponentStub
    Information about a record component: the component's element, and whether there was an accessor in the stubs for that component.
    AnnotationFileParser.RecordStub
    Information about a record from a stub file.
    AnnotationFileResource
    Interface for sources of stub data.
    AnnotationFileUtil
    Utility class for annotation files (stub files and ajava files).
    AnnotationFileUtil.AnnotationFileType
    The types of files that can contain annotations.
    BinaryStubBundle
    In-memory index of a binary stub bundle: a single file combining the binary form of every .astub file under one -Astubs directory, as written by BinaryStubFileGenerator's --bundle mode.
    BinaryStubBundleTest
    Tests that a damaged binary stub bundle is reported as a malformed file, not a crash.
    BinaryStubClasspathTest
    Guards against build-wiring rot for the generated .astub.bin.gz resources.
    BinaryStubData
    In-memory representation of a binary stub file: the annotated JDK (annotated-jdk.bin.gz) or the binary form of a built-in checker stub file (*.astub.bin.gz).
    BinaryStubData.AnnotationRecord
    Annotation data containing its class name and structural element value pairs.
    BinaryStubData.ClassLiteralValue
    Represents a Class literal value.
    BinaryStubData.ClassRecord
    Annotation data for a single class or interface, including its members.
    BinaryStubData.ComponentRecord
    Annotation data for a single record component (i.e., one entry in a record Foo(A a, B b) header).
    BinaryStubData.EnumConstantValue
    Represents an Enum constant value.
    BinaryStubData.FieldRecord
    Annotation data for a single field.
    BinaryStubData.MethodRecord
    Annotation data for a single method or constructor.
    BinaryStubData.NameLiteralValue
    A simple name that refers to a constant, written 'n'.
    BinaryStubData.OperationValue
    An operation in a constant expression, evaluated where the stub file is read, by AnnotationConstants: a unary operation (written 'u'), a binary operation ( 'b'), a conditional expression ('?'), or a cast ('x').
    BinaryStubData.TypeAnno
    Represents a type annotation with its type path, or a marker for a plain wildcard ? (see BinaryStubData.TypeAnno.UNBOUNDED_WILDCARD).
    BinaryStubData.TypeParamRecord
    Annotation data for a single type parameter (class-level or method-level).
    BinaryStubData.TypePathStep
    A single step in a type-annotation path, describing how to navigate from a base type to the component type that carries the annotation.
    BinaryStubDataTest
    Tests that a damaged binary stub file is reported as a malformed file, not as a crash.
    BinaryStubDiffChecker
    Test-only differential checker for the binary stub path.
    BinaryStubReader
    Applies annotation data from a BinaryStubData.ClassRecord to a checker's AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileAnnotations.
    BinaryStubReaderTest
    Unit test for BinaryStubReader.classRecordKind(javax.lang.model.element.ElementKind).
    BinaryStubsCommandLineTest
    End-to-end tests for the reader side of binary -Astubs support: AnnotationFileElementTypes's parseCommandLineStubLocation, parseCommandLineStubResource, commandLineBinaryStub, and the useBinaryForCommandLineStubs gate.
    BinaryStubTypeShapesTest
    Checks, shape by shape, that a -Astubs file gives the same types in its text form and in its binary form.
    FileAnnotationFileResource
    File-based implementation of AnnotationFileResource.
    JarEntryAnnotationFileResource
    JarEntry-based implementation of AnnotationFileResource.
    RemoveAnnotationsForInference
    Process Java source files to remove annotations that ought to be inferred.
    StubAnnotationValuesTest
    Tests that every form of annotation element value that Java permits (JLS 9.7.1) -- constant expressions (JLS 15.29), constants named in all the ways Java scopes them, text blocks, and nested annotations -- has the same value in a stub file as in Java source, whether the stub file is text-parsed (AnnotationFileParser) or read from its binary form (BinaryStubReader).
    StubGenerator
    Generates a stub file from a single class or an entire package.
